name: browser-use
headline: MARM-Systems - AI Memory & Multi-Agent Coordination
short_description: Turn AI into a persistent, memory-powered collaborator. Universal MCP Server (supports HTTP, STDIO, and WebSocket) enabling cross-platform AI memory, multi-agent coordination, and context sharing. Built with MARM protocol for structured reasoning that evolves with your work.
author: Lyellr88

sections.overview:
MARM MCP provides a local-first memory infrastructure for Claude, Gemini, Qwen, and other MCP clients, enabling AI agents to retain decisions, context, and project history across sessions instead of forgetting after each conversation. It operates as a universal MCP Server supporting HTTP, STDIO, and WebSocket transports, with a memory model built on sessions, structured logs, notebooks, summaries, and semantic memories. The system handles session routing, hybrid recall with semantic re-ranking, serialized writes, and rate-limit presets to support everything from solo developers to multi-agent swarms. MARM uses SQLite with WAL mode, connection pooling, and an intelligent write queue to scale safely without losing data integrity. Developers benefit from persistent project history, shared context across agents, and intelligent recall that stays useful as memory grows.
Solo developers maintaining project context and technical decisions across long-running sessions
Multi-agent teams sharing persistent memory and coordinating work through structured logs
DevOps and infrastructure engineers tracking complex configurations across services and deployments
Research teams reusing notebooks, summaries, and semantic memories across collaborative work
